content.title: Upgrade to a Pro subscription
content.description: A free account holder upgrades from the dashboard to the Pro plan through an in-app action that completes without full page navigation, records the new plan persistently on the server, confirms success in the same view, and leaves the account in the `pro` state on a fresh fetch or after reload, with no payment-processing step because the upgrade is defined here as a direct state change.
content.summary: Upgrade a Free account to Pro.
content.value: Moves eligible users onto the paid subscription state and ensures the upgrade is durably recorded for later use of Pro capabilities.
criteria: only Free accounts can upgrade, and the target plan is Pro
after a successful upgrade request, the persisted account plan is `pro` and a fresh fetch confirms it rather than cached state
the dashboard triggers the upgrade without full page navigation and shows success confirmation in the same view
upgrade is a direct state change with no payment step
